about_the_game:
As the world falls apart, only those brave enough to face chaos can keep hope alive. In Elemental Towers VR, you’ll command the power of the four elements and construct legendary towers to bring balance back to the broken world of Elemar. Get ready for breathtaking enigmas, strategic dragon battles, and magical mastery challenges!

  • Story Mode

Dive into the ancient world of Elemar, uncovering its mysteries and restoring the elemental towers. Unlock new mechanics, abilities, and game modes as you progress!

  • Innovative VR Gameplay

Build your tower using Tetris-like blocks, shaping closed loops to climb higher.

  • Epic Dragon Encounters

Defend your tower from the attacks of exotic dragons and emerge victorious in each biome, employing strategic thinking to achieve victory.

  • Magical Powers

Wield the might of the four elemental forces, shatter blocks, trigger special power-ups, and strategically orchestrate the deployment of runes to strengthen your tower against foes.

  • Varied Ecosystems

Explore swamps, ice-capped peaks, floating islands, and rivers of molten lava to bring harmony back to the world.

  • Rune Combos

Master the art of combining elements to unlock powerful synergies, but beware – poor combinations can lead to disaster.

  • Growing Chaos

Act fast! Nature fights back with floods, burning lava, heavy storms, and muddy swamps. The longer you play, the greater the danger.

  • Global Leaderboards

Engage in global competition with players worldwide to achieve the highest score and reach the top of the leaderboard. Prove your skills!

  • Upcoming Multiplayer Mode

Battle it out head-to-head style. A real-time dueling mode is about to be released!

Extra Modes

At launch, two extra modes will be accessible. These modes, in contrast to the Dragon Mode, enable players to concentrate on a singular goal. They are intended to assist players in mastering the game’s mechanics and selecting effective strategies without being distracted by defending tower or enemy assaults.

Construction Mode

A timed challenge where you’re on clock to build your tower without using any magic to destroy Tetris-like blocks. Every choice counts, and success depends on careful planning.

Combo Search Mode

Here, there is no need to close elemental tower loops but you’ll have to deal with rising floodwaters. To survive as long as possible, identify and activate special rune combos to keep the danger at bay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Sandy Bridge or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 Skylake or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR

short_description: Dive into a world of pure magic and ancient enigmas! The game integrates riddles, strategic choices, and exciting battles into a unique VR experience like no other. Control mystical energy, mix elemental runes, crush blocks, and counter enemy attacks to mend the fractured harmony of the elements.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, French, Italian, German
